reply_body: Aapka plan abhi activate nahi hua yeh samajh gaye - woh payment humare system mein complete nahi dikh raha, isliye free version hi show ho raha hai. Aap screenshot bhej sakte hain, humari billing team aapke payment attempt ko check karegi aur status confirm karegi. Thodi der mein update milega.
summary: User reports payment made for plan but plan not activated; payment attempt shows initiated, not confirmed complete.
